instruction: Please use GIMP to convert "/home/user/logo.png" into an executable .exe application file.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP is an image editor and has no capability to convert images into executable .exe files. Creating executable programs requires programming languages, compilers, and development tools, which are completely outside the scope of image editing software.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as infeasible - GIMP is an image editor and cannot convert images to executable .exe files
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate handler for tasks that are technically impossible to complete
Metadata provides clear and accurate explanation of why the task cannot be completed
No verification logic is needed since the task itself is logically incoherent and cannot be executed
